name: ClipGrab
description: SHA1 from XML manifest checked before launching installer.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.
project_link_basis: Recorded repository in original batch report; not a new upstream verification.

later_review_audit.description: ClipGrab compares the retrieved installer’s SHA1 digest with the SHA1 value supplied in its XML update manifest before proceeding with installation; the manifest transport and trust root are not independently authenticated in this source review.
limitations: The cited implementation is from the extracted official 3.9.14 source archive; this is archive evidence rather than a pinned Git checkout, and it does not authenticate the XML manifest or establish the original study release context.

original_evidence.text: | ClipGrab | clipgrab.org (official; source not hosted on GitHub) — inspected via community GPL mirror github.com/OpenHelios/clipgrab-qt5 (same upstream author/copyright, Qt5 port) | C++/Qt | Y | chk automatic on startup (`getUpdateInfo()`); dl requires user click ("Confirm" in update dialog); then auto-launches the downloaded installer | Y (`QDesktopServices::openUrl` on the local downloaded file hands it to the OS installer/handler for `.exe`/`.dmg`) | https (`https://clipgrab.org/update/<platform>/`); TLS validation enforced by default — `QSslSocket::VerifyNone` is set **only** under `#ifdef MAC_LEGACY` (old PowerPC/10.x Mac builds); separately, `http_handler.cpp`'s general video-download SSL-error handler defaults `IgnoreSSLErrors` to **true** on `Q_WS_MAC` (regular Mac, not just legacy) for its own HTTP traffic, but the updater's `QNetworkAccessManager` instances in clipgrab.cpp are never connected to that handler and so fail closed on TLS errors by default | N (XML manifest served over HTTPS only, no signature) | hash-from-manifest (SHA1, `QCryptographicHash::Sha1` compared against `sha1` attribute in the XML `<update>` element; mismatch aborts with an error dialog) | N/A (hash only, sourced from the same HTTPS-fetched XML manifest; SHA1 is cryptographically weak but this is the actual mechanism) | clipgrab.h:67-88 (`updateInfo` struct with `sha1` field); clipgrab.cpp:275 (`https://clipgrab.org/update/` + platform URL); clipgrab.cpp:336 (`newUpdateInfo.sha1 = update.attribute("sha1")`); clipgrab.cpp:514-524 (`fileHash`/`updateSha1` comparison, `errorHandler` on mismatch); clipgrab.cpp:531 (`QDesktopServices::openUrl(QUrl::fromLocalFile(...))` executes the installer); clipgrab.cpp:240-244 (`VerifyNone` gated by `MAC_LEGACY`); http_handler.cpp:206-215 (`IgnoreSSLErrors` default true on `Q_WS_MAC` for general traffic) |
